summary: Iteration 188: tested the simple Start test page, the 60 s get-ready screen (/start get_ready, /begin, /assets/pack, preload), All India series results (score and solutions on submit, rank after the day closes via /series-rank), regular live exams still sealed, My Tests with no embargoed status, and an iteration-187 regression. All tests ran in disposable isolated databases (tejas_isolated_*) through bridges on 127.0.0.1:8770. The preview DB was never written to, and all isolated DBs were dropped. Backend: new suite get_ready_iso188.py passed 47/47; the 187 regression series_dates_iso187.py passed 47/47. Frontend (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): the core flows work. Start page: facts, marking rule, 3 steps, one 'Start test' button, signed-out 'Sign in to start', series note, no integer box, no device check, no checkbox. Start test sends only POST /start (no preflight) and navigates in under 0.1 s. Get-ready: 6 rules, the series result line, the load bar reaches 100% through /assets/pack, Begin is disabled while loading, two forced 503 pack failures are retried and loading still reaches 100%, a reload resumes the remaining seconds, keys pressed during the countdown send no answers, Begin now gives the full 03:00:00 (180 min), the paper opens by itself at 0, and preloaded pictures cause no new asset requests. Submit dialog text for series is correct. Series results show the full result plus series-rank-sealed, and the closed day shows '#1 of 1'. My Tests shows the series score right away and the 'Result sealed' filter is gone. A normal practice flow (answer, autosave, reload, submit, result) works. Found one functional bug (a /visit call plus a duplicate asset fetch during the countdown) and one mobile layout bug (the countdown ring collapses to 14 px wide at 390 px).

minor.issue: The rank counts every completed series_live attempt on the set, including the owner's early-access attempt (role owner) and staff attempts. An owner early attempt is added to the day's total and can push students down. Consider filtering to students only (or competition_ranked).

If any source file in the chunk is missing, sources[r['file_id']] raises KeyError, and if render_crop raises, the whole chunk returns 500. The frontend copes (after 3 failures it fetches pictures one by one), but one bad crop fails 16 pictures at a time. Consider returning per-item errors or skipping bad items.

minor.endpoint: PUT /api/attempts/{id}/answers/{qid} and question assets during ready_until
minor.issue: The backend does not block answers or question pictures before ready_until. A modified client can read or answer the paper during the 60 s and still get the full time after it (fairness, low risk). Consider rejecting answer writes while ready_until > now.

ui_bugs.issue: The useAttempt state `ready` starts at 0 and is only set by an effect. On the first render after the attempt loads, readying=false, so the full player renders for one frame. The visit effect then POSTs /attempts/{id}/visit for Q1 during the countdown (Q1 is marked visited before the paper opens). The frame also fires a duplicate GET asset/question/0 and question-reports. This was seen on every fresh Start test; on reload, /visit was not sent but the duplicate asset and question-reports requests were. Fix: work out readying synchronously from attempt.ready_until and the server clock during render (or initialise `ready` from the attempt), so the player never mounts while ready_until is in the future.

Under @media (max-width) .get-ready-top switches to flex-direction: column with align-items: flex-start. The ring's `flex: 0 0 112px` then sets its height, and its width shrinks to its content (measured 14px x 112px). The SVG ring becomes a tiny dot, and the '59 sec' text sits below it outside the ring. Fix: give .get-ready-ring an explicit width: 112px (and/or align-self: center).

The CSS `.get-ready-ring span {position:absolute; bottom:24px; font-size:11px}` also matches spans nested inside <strong data-testid=get-ready-seconds>. In preview the visual-editor wrapper adds such a span, so the big number shows at 11px (looks tiny on desktop). Use `.get-ready-ring > span` to keep it robust.

issues: Empty band with a divider at the top of the card before the facts row (desktop and mobile)
The icons in the small notes under the button (clock, shield) sit on their own line above the text instead of inline
For series day papers the eyebrow still says 'JEE MAIN · INDEPENDENT PRACTICE' and the back link says 'Back to JEE Main tests' even though returnTo points to the series hub
When the countdown ran out by itself, the timer briefly showed 03:00:01 for a 180-min paper (ceil rounding). Cosmetic.
'Your rank arrives at 2:24 am IST' uses lowercase am, while the rest of the app uses '11:59 PM'

action_items: Player: stop the full player (and the /visit call, asset/question/0 and question-reports fetches) from mounting for one render before GetReady. Work out readying synchronously from ready_until.
CSS: .get-ready-ring needs width:112px (it collapses to 14px wide at 390px); change `.get-ready-ring span` to `.get-ready-ring > span`.
Optional: leave owner/staff early attempts out of series-rank counts; make /assets/pack tolerate one missing or bad crop; reject answer writes while ready_until > now.
Optional design polish: empty top band in the start card, inline note icons, series eyebrow/back-link copy, AM/PM casing.
critical_code_review_comments: attempts.start lead formula matches the spec: lead = max(0, min(60, competition_end - seconds - started_at)), and deadline = ready_until + seconds capped by competition_end. Verified a 20 s lead on a tight window and no ready_until when the window is shorter than the paper.
begin() is race-safe (find_one_and_update conditioned on ready_until) and idempotent. It returns 404 for another user's attempt.

answers_sealed: series attempts are never sealed. Retry, report, solution assets and results are open right after submit for series_live. Product risk: series solutions open while the day is still live (8 AM finishers can share solutions with later starters). The owner accepted this, but it should be documented.

preloadPaper: the retry/backoff and the fallback to single-asset fetches after 3 failures work; the held blobs live through the GetReady to Player switch (no refetch). The pack offset is taken from frontend asset_count order and must stay identical to backend q_refs order; it currently matches.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core flows pass; 1 functional visit-during-countdown bug, 1 mobile ring layout bug)

seed_data_creation: Only inside disposable tejas_isolated_book170_* databases created by the scripts; all dropped. The preview DB was untouched.
test_credentials: No permanent credentials. Random owner and student accounts were created inside the isolated DBs only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: cd /app/backend && timeout 290 python tests/get_ready_iso188.py (about 40 s, prints PASS/FAIL, drops its DB). UI: python tests/ui_bridge188.py 1800 & (fixtures: pic_set = picture book-mock with 180 min, prac_set, day_set = open series_live paper with series_pattern, closed_attempt = series attempt with competition_end in the past; cookies in /tmp/uibridge/bridge.json with keys owner and student). In Playwright, route **/api/** to http://127.0.0.1:8770 with the cookie header. The results page route is /results/<id> (not /attempts/<id>/results). Series day papers need series_pattern = live_series.paper_pattern(set), otherwise start returns 409 'needs owner review'. The retry payload needs start_key. Retest: no /visit before Begin now on a fresh start, and ring width 112px at 390px.
rca of the issue: Visit during countdown: useAttempt sets `ready` in a useEffect after the attempt state is set, so the first Player render has ready=0, readying=false, and the full player tree mounts. Its useEffect(visit) fires before the ready effect re-renders into GetReady. Mobile ring: the column flex layout plus flex-basis on the ring element leaves its width undefined (it shrinks to content).
